title: Turn a whole omelet over with a dinner plate
context: A dinner plate lets a cook turn a thick Spanish omelet in one piece. The cook catches it on the plate, sets the skillet upright and slides the omelet back to cook the second side.
setup: Cold 156 × 50 mm hob and 175 mm aluminum skillet (235 g), dry silicone handle toward the left arm. Center a one-piece, washable, 130 × 21 mm American basswood disk (120 ± 3 g) with the marked face down. Both sliding faces are bare P320-finished wood. A smooth polypropylene dinner plate (244 mm, 160 g) starts face down on a 66 mm wire rack to the right. Both hands start empty.
scoring: Sequential credits are 0.15 for the rim cover, 0.35 for a covered steep tilt, 0.60 for the inverted catch, 0.75 for plate-only support for 0.2 s, and 0.85 for a downhill slide of at least 20 mm toward the upright skillet. Full credit requires the last 1.0 s to show the browned face up in the upright skillet, supported on the hob, plate clear and both hands released. Loss of any final condition returns the score to 0.85 immediately. A drop or direct hand contact with the replica scores zero.
fidelity: The model uses physical pad contacts, gravity and sliding friction with a rigid disk. YAM actuator settings are checked against the installed station. The setup includes a repeatable cold replica specification and a separate force-and-slide bench protocol. Hardware trials remain pending. Cooking, adhesion and soft-food fracture are outside the model.
reset_notes: Wash the disk by hand, rinse and dry to stable mass. Verify both contact faces on the actual clean, dry aluminum pan and polypropylene plate against the inclined-slide limits in the README. Reset marked face down, grain across the discharge direction, plate face down and grippers open.
instruction: Use the plate to turn the whole omelet over. Slide it back into the skillet, browned side up, and set the skillet down.
scores: Scripted demo 1.0 in 1,135 actions. A separate run of the same fixed setup scored 1.0 in 1,135 actions. Dream-1 scored 0.0 in 1,200 actions.
